summary: We had a $100 payment (on top of the $468) when paying the bill the decimal was missed. $10000 instead of $100.00. Wiped out life savings, never recovered, could not get refund. At least we only owe $468 a month.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
We had a $100 payment (on top of the $468) when paying the bill the decimal was missed. $10000 instead of $100.00. Wiped out life savings, never recovered, could not get refund.

At least we only owe $468 a month.
